# Felipe Tuyama

> Personal portfolio of Felipe Tuyama, remote Senior Software Engineer specializing in Ruby, Vue.js, TypeScript, and AI engineering.

Remote senior software engineer based in Brazil with 10+ years of experience. Currently at The Reformation. ITA Computer Engineering (2017), MSc Software Architecture & Design (MTU, 2025).

## Portfolio
- [Home](https://ftuyama.github.io/): Main portfolio with experience, skills, and projects
- [About](https://ftuyama.github.io/#about-me): Background, education, and social links
- [Experience](https://ftuyama.github.io/#experiences): Work history and timeline
- [Skills](https://ftuyama.github.io/#skills): Technical skills and languages

## Projects
- [Git Light](https://ftuyama.github.io/git-light/): Free open-source desktop Git client with commit graph
- [Silent Dungeon](https://ftuyama.github.io/silent-dungeon/): Interactive fiction game — A Masmorra do Silêncio
- [Cracking the Tech Interview](https://ftuyama.github.io/cracking-the-tech-interview/): Live library for technical interview preparation
